title: 🌦️ The Weather Lab Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are running experiments in the weather lab, and each one has a favorite station AND a favorite kind of day to watch out the window. Can you sort them all out?
clues: Luna's experiment is not Volcano, Magnets, or Stargazing.
Bella's favorite weather is not Sunny or Rainy.
Whoever's favorite weather is Cloudy loves Stargazing.
Whoever's favorite weather is Snowy loves Magnets.
Oliver's favorite weather is not Snowy.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three experiments for Luna all at once -- whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's favorite weather directly: Rainy. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat -- they link a kind of weather straight to an experiment. Once you know a cat's experiment, check whether it matches either of those clues.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two weather choices left. Try combining it with clue 5 (Snowy -> Magnets) to see which one fits Bella.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers sort out Whiskers and Oliver -- use clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's weather.
